title: iem_pbank_csv
description: `iem_pbank_csv` is a parameter bank that stores parameter sets in numbered memory lines and reads or writes them using CSV-like syntax. Its first creation argument sets the number of parameters and its second sets the number of lines; a line can be stored from the input buffer or recalled to the buffer and output as a complete parameter list. For `read` and `write`, a two-character format symbol such as `br` selects the item separator and end-of-line style.
